name: emr-dashboard
description: Web app điều phối dữ liệu giường bệnh, y lệnh và tự động nhập EMR

scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,UI -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:ui"
scripts.test:ci: python -m pytest tests/ -q && python -m compileall -q worker && node scripts/check.mjs && npm run test:ui && node scripts/workflow_smoke_test.js && node scripts/records_check_paper_status_test.js && node scripts/task_queue_account_lane_test.js && node scripts/records_check_shared_data_reuse_test.js && node scripts/research_hchanh_flatten_encounter_guard_test.js && node scripts/hchanh_fetch_case_key_ambiguity_test.js && node scripts/records_check_legacy_migration_test.js && node scripts/orphan_fetch_temp_cleanup_test.js && node scripts/discharge_print_bundle_location_test.js && node scripts/hchanh_open_bed_edit_dedup_test.js && node scripts/bhyt_pre_audit_tier1_test.js

notes.dev_workflow: npm run dev  →  UI: http://localhost:5173  |  API: http://localhost:3001
notes.prod_workflow: npm install → npm start → tự build UI nếu cần → http://localhost:3001
